_comment: THE LAW BASELINE — see the LAW RATCHET comment in scripts/registry-validate.mjs. Rewritten only by `npm run law:baseline`, a Janitor-or-coordinator act after debt is paid, never routine.

served-page-contact-line.law: CURATION #privacy-redaction / #privacy (v74): a living person's contact detail is redacted in ANY context — a served page may not carry an e-mail address, AIM/ICQ/MSN/Yahoo handle or screen name behind its own label

served-page-handler-credit.law: CURATION #privacy (v74, out-of-character structures) + LAW-INDEX 2a: a Handler / Handled by / Written by credit naming a person is out of fiction and redacts — the persona serves, the credit does not

live-site-served.law: CURATION #dead-only-rule as amended v75/v98 + GAVELS 2026-08-26 THE LIVING-PRESERVATION CLAUSE: a living promotion IS collected and NEVER served — a wing whose own frontier row is verified-alive may hold no served document

epitaph-missing-tier1plus.law: CURATION #promotion-epitaphs + PROCESS 'Frontier -> Tier 0' step 4 (no epitaph owed BELOW tier 1): every wing at tier 1 or above carries a written Epitaph section on its own landing page

epitaph-present-total.law: CURATION #promotion-epitaphs: an epitaph already written is never lost — a regeneration that strips one (wce/whq/wwe-the-efed, 2026-09) drops this count and fails here

house-style-missing-tier2plus.law: CURATION #tier-and-storylines + PROCESS 'Tier 1 -> Tier 2' step 4: a tier-2+ federation owes a graded, sourced house_style (community hubs owe none)

storylines-missing-tier3.law: CURATION #tier-and-storylines: storylines are tier 3's OUTPUT — a tier-3 wing without a Storylines section has not had the crawl that earned its tier

served-text-narration.law: CURATION #protagonist-test + THE SERVED-TEXT RULE (the Janitor 2026-09-05): no served field carries workshop process narration

award-recipient-unminted.law: GAVELS 2026-09-13 rule 10 (AWARD RECIPIENTS ARE MINTED) + LAW-INDEX 2b: every bestowal recipient carries a character/unit id, even when the bestowal is all that is known

promotion-source-kind-unknown.law: CURATION #medium-defined discipline, applied to sources[].kind: a source kind is a deliberate, documented addition, never a value invented in the data (the 'attachment' kind, gate 143 run 6)

document-source-kind-unknown.law: CURATION #medium-defined discipline applied to sources[].kind: a source kind is a deliberate, documented addition, never a value invented in a lane brief (the 'attachment' kind, gate 143 run 6)

document-source-workshop-url.law: GAVELS 2026-09-07 SOURCE LINKS + CURATION #provenance-per-accession-lot: a served document cites its PUBLIC source (Google Groups / Wayback / the original URL) — never a workshop file path, which the provenance renderer turns into a broken internal link (gate 143 run 4)

promotion-provenance-notes-missing.law: docs/SCHEMA.md provenance_notes[] ('individually graded founding-fact claims'): every promotion row carries at least one TYPED provenance record. See the PROVENANCE BREACH note below — while the recorded debt is above zero this is ratcheted; the moment the baseline reads 0 the per-row check below becomes a HARD FAILURE on its own

provenance-note-total.law: THE FIELD-COUNT RATCHET, and the reason it exists: the floor is 6,389 — the number of typed provenance records standing on 1,384 of 1,388 promotion rows at commit fbb3965d87 (chain 139, 2026-09-13), every one of which was gone by e82bf9dbc2 (chain 140, 2026-09-14) with five days of gates reporting '0 entries seen ... OK'. The floor is DELIBERATELY set above today's count: this rule is RED until the records are rebuilt from the pre-drop commit and the per-wing narratives (in the workshop), which is the correct state for a gate to be in while 6,389 authored records are missing

provenance-note-untyped.law: PROVENANCE-NOTES-01 (2026-09-13): a legacy {claim, evidence} note is converted to a typed record, never left in place

controlled-value-outside-enum.law: CURATION #medium-defined + the Janitor's 2026-09-10 gavel (medium is the PLATFORM; form is what the canon physically is; authorship is who writes it): a medium/form/play/authorship value outside its documented set is a typo or an undocumented invention, never a silent new vocabulary — the served placard reads it straight out ('Play: Booked')

aka-narration.law: SCHEMA aka[] ('a label the fed itself used') + THE SERVED-TEXT RULE: an aka is a LABEL, never a sentence about the label — a parenthetical explanation belongs in provenance_notes

source-link-missing-forward.law: GAVELS 2026-09-07 SOURCE LINKS, a FORWARD rule: every document added from that day on links its public source. A page whose provenance Source line carries no <a href> and whose served_since is 2026-09-08 or later is a breach of the forward rule, not backfill debt

source-link-missing-total.law: the same gavel read as the backfill queue: every served document eventually links its public source (the Janitor's own words: 'ensure every document we add with a public source explicitly links to that source')

house-style-present-total.law: the field-count ratchet (coordinator, 2026-09-19): a count that only ever grows may not fall — house styles are written once and never lost to a regeneration

source-link-present-total.law: the field-count ratchet (coordinator, 2026-09-19): a count that only ever grows may not fall — a source link, once written, is never lost to a regeneration

documents-rows-total.law: the field-count ratchet: documents.json rows are only ever added (a withdrawal is a deliberate, ruled act that re-baselines); a drop is a lost provenance record, not a curation decision

document-doc-class-outside-v109.law: CURATION #serve-by-document-class v109(a) names ELEVEN classes (card, rp, roster, rules, news, staff, credits, guestbook, board, column, other) plus v111(e)'s machine-translation; `roleplay` is documents.json's own spelling of `rp`. Anything else — index, poll, charter, faq, none — is a class nobody ruled on, and v109(b)-(e) cannot be read off it
